source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Take the average of each recorded value.
3. Get a range (MAX-MIN) for each record set. Do this for each record set of data.
4. Convert the range to an error factor.

## Error factor formula:
_Error Factor = (range / average) x 100_

5. Calculate the error standard deviation. [Standard Deviation calculator can be found here](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/statistics/standard-deviation-calculator.php)
4. Determine the number of standard deviations between said average and the farthest range value.
5. Determine the Z-Score. [Z-Score calculator can be found here](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/statistics/z-score-calculator.php)
6. Take the data from here to our statisti.ca spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spread
